Package sootup.callgraph.scope

Class CallFilter

java.lang.Object
sootup.callgraph.scope.CallFilter
public final class CallFilter extends Object
The calls of a method that a CallResolver lets the call graph algorithm resolve: all(), none() or those of the statements accepted by a predicate (of(java.util.function.Predicate<sootup.core.jimple.common.stmt.InvokableStmt>)). Only none() lets the algorithm skip the method without loading its body.
